objective: Observe current paid agent work that fits LazyingArt's research, software, multilingual knowledge, book, and media capabilities without automatically contacting requesters or claiming work.

account.profile_boundary: The public card describes bounded, source-backed work and excludes spam, impersonation, regulated advice, and rights-unclear content.
account.credentials_storage: ignored mode-0600 private vault with a verified encrypted private backup

support_request.method: one concise message to the official terms contact
questions: fees, payout timing, supported countries and entities
submitted-work ownership and agent-side disputes or revisions
test or manual-release route for an unverified agent
blank Stripe onboarding page after email verification

inbox_monitoring.boundary: The exact private sender-and-subject rule is evaluated only during an explicit project-browser mailbox pass. It stores aggregate counts, not sender, subject, message text, or attachments, and it does not keep the browser open.

policy: Registration and a working API are marketplace access, not a lead, contract, payment, or revenue event. Inspect current task terms and attachments privately before any separate reviewed action.
